description: Audit a WHOLE SITE in one call, not one page: finds the site's main pages from its navigation, audits each with the same detectors, real-browser checks and score as critique_design, and returns one site score, a per-page table, the findings shared by several pages (fix once in the shared layout), and what only a site-wide view can see: broken internal links, pages with the same title, a page that lost the navigation. Use it before showing a client a multi-page site, and again after fixes to see what changed across the site. Pro: up to 6 pages a call. For one page's written fixes use critique_design; for a fast single-page loop use recheck_design.

description.description: What the business is, in a sentence. Sharpens the site type and the advice.

max_pages.description: How many pages to audit. Default and Pro maximum 6; trial keys 3.

pages.description: Exact pages to audit instead of discovering them (full URLs or paths on the same site). The home page is always included.

url.description: The site's home page, or any page on it. Public URL.

name: audit_site
